integration.name: Vonage
integration.summary: Formerly Nexmo. Rich direct routes across Europe and North America, and one of the highest default throughput tiers we ship with.

credentials.label: API Secret
credentials.note: Paired with the API key above.

config.label: Sender identities
config.note: Numbers or alphanumeric sender IDs, depending on the destination.

strengths: Direct routes across Europe and North America
Supports alphanumeric sender IDs where the destination allows them
Highest default pacing among the providers we integrate
considerations: Alphanumeric sender IDs are not accepted in every country, and some destinations require a pre-registered sender. That registration happens in the Vonage portal.
